name: Consensus-rating side
signal: Bet the side implied by the average of two shrunk ratings when both estimators agree ≤1.0 pt.
universe: every game in the rolling 3-day window (today..today+3)
settlement_rule: settled only from official finals published on nba.com game pages; ties/pushes per the originated line's half-point quoting; no line is staked until gates G6 and G7 pass
